name: Ogawa Masami
source:
Hobbies: Watching Anime.
Likes: Anime in general.
Dislikes: Live-action series in general.
Relation to the protagonist: A character from her new work is very similar to [url=/c12036]Akira[/url].

Masami is a popular amongst women and girls Boys' school life ranobe writer. One of her works even has an anime adaptation. She is good at lightly naughty text depictions, especially the depiction of tits (and character with big tits in particular). Akira fully approves of her works.
